In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the localist representations of the hidden space in the deep generative models are a better fit for representing the deep, hierarchical structure of speech dynamics than the distributed representations in the deep discriminative models.

the two types of models are complementary to each other and should be integrated in a principled way to achieve the most effective and efficient representation of speech dynamics in deep neural networks for speech recognition and related technologies.

, while both the generative and discriminative models are powerful and effective, they are not necessarily complementary.
